user.title: Family Calendar
user.description: Registers the Family Calendar card in the frontend. Invitation sync can be set up afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Family Calendar is already set up.

init.title: Import invitations from a mailbox
init.description: Invite an address of this mailbox as an attendee and the event appears in the mapped calendar. Routing uses plus addressing: an invitation to mailbox+mike@… lands in the calendar mapped to the tag mike.

data_description.imap_password: Gmail requires an app password; the regular account password will not work.
data_description.calendar_mapping: One line per calendar, in the form: mike = calendar.mike
data_description.fallback_calendar: Where invitations go whose plus tag is not in the mapping. Leave empty to discard them.
data_description.allowed_senders: Comma-separated addresses. Leaving this empty means anyone who knows the mailbox address can add events.

error.invalid_mapping: Each line must read tag = calendar.entity.
error.credentials_required: Username and password are required for the sync.
